name: @dzup-ui/docs
description: Public documentation site for dzup-ui (TASK-N2-D1) — a renderer over packages/core/docs/component-meta.json, never a second source of API facts

scripts.//generate: TASK-N2-D1. Emits every generated page under apps/docs/components/ from packages/core/docs/component-meta.json. Asserts the artifact is FRESH first (the same re-extract-and-compare clause `yarn validate:component-meta` runs), so a stale artifact stops the site build before a single page is written.
scripts.dev: yarn generate && yarn playground && vitepress dev
scripts.//build: The generate step is part of the build on purpose: a stale metadata artifact must turn the SITE build red, not just a separate validator. The size budget is part of it for the same reason (TASK-R1-O5): the build that PRODUCES the 33 MB artifact is the place a ceiling has to bite, and --require-dist turns the validator's fresh-clone skip into an error here, where the dist has just been written.
scripts.build: yarn generate && yarn playground && vitepress build && yarn --cwd ../.. validate:docs-size --require-dist
scripts.//size: TASK-R1-O5. The ceiling, its seed measurement and the reason for it live in packages/tooling/src/validators/docs-size-ceilings.json, and ONE implementation reads them (packages/tooling/src/validators/docs-size.ts) — the same one `yarn validate:all` runs. This delegates rather than re-measuring, exactly as `check` above delegates to validate:docs-pages. The predecessor, scripts/report-size.mjs, was a reporter whose own header named this promotion path: 'one local build is not a trusted baseline'. Four packets and 17 MB later it was.
scripts.//playground: TASK-N2-D3. Runs the SINGLE playground bundle producer (apps/storybook/scripts/build-playground.mjs) and copies its three assets here. Not a second bundler -- the same one-producer/N-consumers shape TASK-N2-A3 gave apps/storybook/scripts/build-llms.mjs. --check asserts the copies are byte-identical to the producer output.
